desc.en: A monster with sharp sickles on both arms. It's said that one will not survive an encounter with it, and is thus known as the Reaper. Although there shouldn't be any information about it if everyone who saw it died...
desc.ja: 両手に鋭いカマを持っている魔物。出会ったら最後、生きては帰れないといわれ、死神と呼ばれるようになった。が生きて帰れないなら目撃情報がないはずだが…
